run_completion: run a synchronous Azure AI agent completion with messages and return the assistant response
run_acompletion: run an asynchronous Azure AI agent completion with messages and return the assistant response
run_acompletion_stream: run an async streaming Azure AI agent completion using native SSE and yield response chunks
build_agent_thread_url: build the Azure AI agent thread creation URL from api_base and api_version parameters
build_agent_messages_url: build the Azure AI agent messages URL for a given thread_id and api_version
build_agent_runs_url: build the Azure AI agent runs URL for a given thread_id and api_version
build_agent_run_status_url: build the Azure AI agent run status URL for a given thread_id and run_id
build_agent_create_thread_and_run_url: build the Azure AI agent create-thread-and-run URL for streaming requests
extract_content_from_messages: extract assistant text content and annotations from Azure AI agent messages response data
transform_annotations: transform Azure AI Foundry annotations to OpenAI-compatible format with url_citation fields
build_model_response: build a ModelResponse object from agent content with usage estimation and thread_id storage
prepare_completion_params: prepare headers, api_version, agent_id, thread_id and api_base for Azure AI agent completion
check_response: check an HTTP response status code and raise AzureAIAgentsError if not in expected codes
execute_agent_flow_sync: execute the full sync agent flow: create thread, add messages, create run, poll, retrieve response
execute_agent_flow_async: execute the full async agent flow: create thread, add messages, create run, poll, retrieve response
process_sse_stream: process Azure AI agent SSE stream events and yield OpenAI-compatible streaming chunks
review_AzureAIAgentsHandler: review the AzureAIAgentsHandler class and its multi-step agent flow implementation
summarize_completion: summarize the completion method that executes the Azure AI agent multi-step flow synchronously
